```powershell
PS C:\repo> npm run lint
```

```bash
bash -c "npm run gen && npm run build"
```

snippets.text:
```
make fmt; make vet || make lint
```

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm test
```
Fix lint with `pnpm lint:fix`. For styles, run `pnpm run lint:css`. JS only: `pnpm run lint:js`.
The `build` script runs tsc. Never run npm run deploy by hand, CI does that. Locally, `npm run build` is enough.

```bash
make <target>
npm run $SCRIPT
yarn {name}
make help
```

```bash
yarn workspace api test
npm --prefix client run build
npm run lint -w packages/ui
npm run typecheck
```
